minedSpec:
# PROPOSED rules, mined from the code (daedalus mine-rules; src/rule-mining). Not a reviewed spec: review before use.
# style: clean-architecture (ISE, confidence 1.00); layers: ISE preset-first
# mined rules: 8 (8 emitted)
# MR-001 [layer-direction, high 0.87] domain must not depend on application (17 edges application -> domain; 0/11 domain files import application)
# MR-002 [layer-direction, high 0.79] domain must not depend on infrastructure (6 edges infrastructure -> domain; 0/11 domain files import infrastructure)
# MR-003 [layer-direction, high 0.81] application must not depend on infrastructure (10 edges infrastructure -> application; 0/8 application files import infrastructure)
# MR-004 [acyclic-files, high 0.97] no file lies on an import cycle (29/29 files do not)
# MR-005 [component-direction, high 0.79] folder component domain must not depend on infrastructure (6 imports infrastructure -> domain; 0/11 files import back)
# MR-006 [component-direction, high 0.87] folder component domain must not depend on application (17 imports application -> domain; 0/11 files import back)
# MR-007 [component-direction, high 0.81] folder component application must not depend on infrastructure (10 imports infrastructure -> application; 0/8 files import back)
# MR-008 [inject-abstractions, high 0.88] classes of application inject interfaces across layers, not concrete classes (7/7)

spec_version: "1.0.0"

architecture:
  style: clean-architecture

  layers:
    - name: domain
      directories:
        - src/domain/**
      roles:
        - entity
        - value-object
        - domain-service
        - repository-interface

    - name: application
      directories:
        - src/application/**
      roles:
        - use-case
        - dto
        - application-service

    - name: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/infrastructure/**
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - controller
        - middleware
        - orm-entity
